cases.name: ICU septic shock and pneumonia
cases.inputText: a 86 years old female patient admitted to the ER, hypotensive blood pressure 80/50, feverish 38.5 degree, dyspnea, cough, desaturated on room air ER vitals: temperature: 38.5, blood pressure: 80/50, spo2: 85 %, HR: 110, RR: 30 past medication history: on concor 2.5 mg, Targ 80, aspirin 75 mg once daily, plavix 75 mg once daily CT chest: consolidation right lower lobe pneumonia. labs: Hb: 9.5, TLC: 22,000, platelet: 25,000, srcr: 2.5, k: 3, mg: 1.6, albumin: 2.5

cases.name: HIV advanced disease with opportunistic infection
cases.inputText: 42-year-old patient with advanced HIV disease, CD4 count 48 cells/uL, presenting with fever, weight loss, and pulmonary symptoms. Chest imaging shows diffuse infiltrates. Sputum PCR positive for Pneumocystis jirovecii. Currently on trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole prophylaxis.

cases.name: HIV with tuberculosis co-infection
cases.inputText: 38-year-old patient with known HIV infection not on antiretroviral therapy, presenting with chronic cough, night sweats, and weight loss. Sputum AFB smear positive. Chest X-ray shows upper lobe cavitary lesions.
